## Goal
Establish the Nomiq repository structure and engineering baseline (Phase 0).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Traceable requirements (REQ-IDs) from the product brief
- [ ] System + hardware architecture, pin map, power tree
- [ ] Specs: air protocol, LoRa link budget (India), STT trade study, power budget, UI/storage
- [ ] ADRs 0001–0004
- [ ] Firmware ESP-IDF skeleton + host-tested protocol core
- [ ] Parametric enclosure (build123d) + KiCad project skeleton
- [ ] MCP config (KiCad, build123d, FreeCAD) and engineer agents
- [ ] Git bot + CI
